module: GE extension `core_vehiclePaints`: vehicle paint management. Reads the paint library files (paints, multiPaintSetups, paintCollections) through core_vehicles, resolves the paints declared by each model and each config (`setupPaints`, called by core_vehicles.getModel), compares the paints of a .pc with those of the model/library, and draws random paints according to the randomPaintDistribution / randomMultiPaintDistribution distributions. A paint is a table {baseColor = {r,g,b,a}, metallic, roughness, clearcoat, clearcoatRoughness, name, class...}.
usage:
-- Random paints for a config
local r = core_vehiclePaints.getRandomPaints('etk800', '854_190d_A')
print(r.type, r.paintName1, r.paintName2, r.paintName3)
-- Three paint names for an existing vehicle
local names = core_vehiclePaints.getRandomPaintsByVehicle(be:getPlayerVehicleID(0))
core_vehicle_manager.setVehicleColorsNames(be:getPlayerVehicleID(0), names)
notes: Library paints are keyed by id; the special paint '_missing_paint_' (gray 0.5) serves as a fallback value. Entries marked `_official` come from official content files (Author = 'BeamNG' or official path).

getRandomPaintsByVehicle reads `obj.jbeam` (lowercase) whereas the rest of the code uses `veh.JBeam`; depending on the case the engine accepts for this field, the model may be nil, in which case the function returns {'White','White','White'} with a warning.

paintSignature.desc: Canonical JSON string of a paint ({baseColor, clearcoat, clearcoatRoughness, metallic, roughness}, 5 decimals) used to compare two paints.

multiPaintSetupSignature.desc: Signature of a set of 3 paints: {"paint1":..,"paint2":..,"paint3":..} where each element is a paintSignature.

multiPaintSetup.desc: table with paint1, paint2, paint3 (full paints)

setupPaints.desc: Prepares the paints of a model and its configs: collects direct paints, libraryPaints, paintCollections, resolves multiPaintSetups and default paints (model first, then configs) and finalizes the classes. Modifies `model` and `configs` in place. Called by core_vehicles.getModel.

writePcPaintsAsInfoPaints.desc: Writes the paints of a .pc as `defaultMultiPaintSetup` of an info file, with explicit paints (class 'hidden', named '<config> Paint N'). Modifies infoData.

convertPcPaintsToInfoPaints.desc: Like writePcPaintsAsInfoPaints, but reuses an existing reference (model paint, library paint, or equivalent multiPaintSetup found by signature) when one exists, instead of duplicating the paint.

modelName.desc: model, to look up its paints

validatePcPaints.desc: Analyzes the paints of a .pc: for each of the 3, indicates whether it matches a model paint, a library paint or is custom, and whether the set matches a known multiPaintSetup.

returns.desc: {paints = {{index, source ('model'|'library'|'custom'), modelPaintName, libraryPaintId, libraryPaintName, resolvedReference}}, multiPaintSetup = {found, source, name, id}, defaultStorageMode ('individualPaints'|'multiPaintSetup'), canOverridePaints, modelDefaultColors, modelDefaultMultiPaintSetup}

getRandomPaints.desc: Randomly draws a paint entry according to the config's probabilities (or the model's by default). The helper is built on first request.

config_key.desc: config key (may have no config of its own: then the model is used)

returns.desc: {type ('paint' or multiPaintSetup), paintName1, paintName2, paintName3, probability}

getRandomPaintsByVehicle.desc: Draws paints for an existing vehicle, based on its model and config (extracted from partConfig).

returns.desc: {name1, name2, name3} usable by core_vehicle_manager.setVehicleColorsNames; {'White','White','White'} if the vehicle or config is not found

createRandomMultiPaintSetup.desc: Generates a random multiPaintSetup by drawing three single paints (the distribution's multiPaintSetups are ignored).

avoidDuplicates.desc: if true, a paint already drawn cannot be drawn again

testRandomPaint.desc: Test tool: draws `amount` paints and logs (level I) the resulting distribution.
